title: Complete class feature, feat, resource, and progression procedures
description:
Complete the deterministic procedures for class features and feats, and correct
resource, reset, and progression modelling.

Root cause: resets are bound to keyword presence rather than to the governing
clause, use-count and die/feature scaling are dropped from typed progression, and
resources are emitted from mechanics-atom presence rather than from a source
clause that establishes them.

Required membership — all of:
- Wild Shape, Bardic Inspiration, Song of Rest, Ki and its three abilities,
  Second Wind, Rage-related procedures, Lay on Hands, Deflect Missiles, Divine
  Sense, Indomitable, Arcane Recovery, Natural Recovery, Circle Spells, Primeval
  Awareness, and every feature surfaced by the four reviews;
- remove phantom resources;
- bind reset to the governing clause rather than to keyword presence
  (Arcane Recovery and Natural Recovery reset wrongly today);
- preserve use-count and die/feature scaling in typed progression
  (Indomitable use scaling is wrong; Divine Sense use count is missing);
- complete Grappler's pin action and lifecycle;
- type fixed proficiency targets.

Closes findings: SOL-003, F-03, F-04, F-05, F-06, F-07, F-10, F-12, F-15, F-24,
CAP-002, CAP-005.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every deterministic feature/feat clause is option-local, level-aware, executable, and linked to required engine capability IDs.
- Reset semantics derive from the governing source clause; a keyword match alone cannot produce a reset.
- No phantom resource survives a corpus-wide predicate.
- Use counts and scaling dice are typed per level, not described in prose.
- Ki save DC and the three Ki abilities are typed, not swallowed by feature prose.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership

cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,

close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
